results.answer: Hello! Welcome to Stackular — feel free to ask me anything about our services or company. 👋
Stackular was founded by Jason Storch (Founder & CEO) and Venkat Varkala (Founder & CTO).
Stackular has offices in Columbia, Maryland (USA), Chicago, Illinois (USA), Hyderabad (India), and San José (Costa Rica).

results.q: Does Stackular have an office in Chicago?
results.answer: Yes, Stackular has an office in Chicago, Illinois, USA.
Stackular provides end‑to‑end product development, UX/UI redesign, and modern data platform solutions across industries such as healthcare, mobility, commercial, and hospitality.
